name: Vincennes Bay Flowline 1
description_en: Representative 2 km flowline for the Vincennes Bay basin, spanning about 490 km from the inland catchment to the floating terminus.
description_zh: 基于原始 BedMachine 与冰流速场提取的 Vincennes Bay流域 代表性 2 km 流线，沿程约 490 公里，连接内陆汇流区与下游浮动末端。

key_facts_en: Peak observed flow speed along the line is about 3091 m/yr.
Minimum bed elevation reaches -1458 m and maximum ice thickness reaches 3637 m.
The extracted line includes a floating shelf section near the downstream end.
key_facts_zh: 沿线最大观测流速约为每年 3091 米。
最低基岩高程约为 -1458 米，最大冰厚约为 3637 米。
这条流线在下游末端包含浮冰架段。
